verdict.rationale: Honeycomb documents collecting traces, logs, and metrics in one platform via OpenTelemetry/OTLP, including SDK metrics and Kubernetes logs and metrics. Traces and logs are stored as structured events indexed on every field and queryable together, and the demo mentions correlating app and Kubernetes errors. However, there is little evidence of a pivot workflow that carries shared context between metrics, logs, and traces. One community report describes a team still keeping logs and metrics in other tools and saying no single tool connects them, which tempers confidence but is not a concrete failure of Honeycomb. Missing for 10: documented cross-signal pivoting (e.g. metric-to-trace or log-to-trace jump with shared context), evidence that metrics live in the same query model as events, independent hands-on corroboration of unified correlation.
